title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Ch. whereas, as regards the posting of workers, the Court of Justice judgment in the RegioPost case1a confirmed that contracting authorities may set a higher level of wages than the general standard as a performance condition for a contract; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Judgment of 17 November 2015, RegioPost GmbH & Co. KG v Stadt Landau in der Pfalz, C-115/14, ECLI:EU:C:2015:760.
